item.title: Drone attack near market kills 80 in Sudan; UN condemns deadly wave of strikes
item.description: A drone strike near a market in the southern Sudanese town of al-Dibab in West Kordofan state killed at least 80 people on Sunday evening, mostly commuters gathering to travel home after the market day ended, according to witnesses and medical sources.
